Use the right-side rear view only for understanding geometry, never as a second output subject. Keep the same stance, arm weapons lowered, no firing effects. Detailed realistic neutral-lit game-asset cutout, crisp edges and accurate hard-surface forms. One complete mech and one pose only. Both shoulder tops, head, complete weapons, hoses and both feet must be inside the image. Figure at most 82 percent of canvas height with generous empty transparent padding above, below and on both sides. Fully transparent background, no room, floor, shadow, reflection, halo, smoke, scenery, overlay text, border, watermark or duplicated mech. Do not replace this original ME2 model with a redesign.
